confirmed_decisions.primary_readout: Disjoint half-domain positive activity excess above instantaneous spatial minimum. D=(E_right-E_left)/(E_right+E_left). Freeze incumbent basal half-height support; retain own-cue and fixed-widest-zone amounts with overlap flags separately.
confirmed_decisions.eligibility: Require at least 1% of frozen basal total excess and dimensionless contrast at least max(0.05,10% of frozen basal contrast), with absolute native amount tolerance. Store 0.5/2-fold sensitivity to both basal fractions. Ineligible states have D=null, replacement=false and explicit reason.
confirmed_decisions.spring: Nominal comparison length /15 gives Spring resting length; widths [0.025,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4]. Own cue support follows instantaneous physical geometry; fixed-widest zone is mapped at basal geometry and frozen in material coordinates.
confirmed_decisions.reference_area: Native peak times 3.8; Spring native peak times 0.1. This is commanded spatial area per ON time, with actual quadrature normalization; it is not cumulative molecular or optical dose.

central_claim: Similar size-dependent replacement resistance arises through distinct mechanisms, which predict different responses to the shape and timing of a cue.
success_criterion: Show positive, measurable challenge-response signatures that distinguish explanations for size-dependent replacement resistance; Wave-pinning must have a positive signature rather than identification by exclusion.
scientific_constraints: Length represents WGD-associated enlargement under unchanged native local kinetics, not within-cell elongation during a turn.
Keep observed migration summaries, conditional OU velocity-memory estimates, deterministic polarity replacement and activity-heading memory distinct.
A 50% reduction of incumbent excess is not replacement.
Equal-peak width changes confound width and integrated input; the new shape contrast must fix integrated area and vary peak inversely with width.
Do not call the mechanism shared-pool competition based only on a length series that changes pool size, incumbent extent and separation together.
The post-withdrawal stall is a finite-horizon, exact-share result with reported residual drift, not an established permanent stable state or unique model signature.
Do not infer an exclusive Wave-pinning identity if Holmes 3 shares the narrow-cue penalty and gap ratchet; report the supported class of mechanisms.
Separate final fate from full-native-field finite-tail stability for every withdrawn run.
Do not describe integrated native input as calibrated photon dose; the native-to-optical calibration is absent according to the brief.
Every pilot number and pilot mechanism interpretation remains provisional until the campaign and source audits substantiate it.

consolidated_plate_20261019: Panel D broad/narrow equal-peak comparison changes integrated dose with width.

signature_matrix_20261020: User considers Goryachev initiation and deBelly dwell-gated commitment sound positive signatures.

The stall may resolve under noise; slow two-peak coarsening is generic to mass-conserved saturating reaction-diffusion models.
The shared-pool explanation lacks an isolated causal contrast.
